state: U.T. Administration of Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu
other_conditions: Must be a registered member of the Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board of the UT
Must have at least 10 years of membership with the Board
Must have worked in building or construction for at least 90 days in a given year
benefits_summary: Provides a monthly pension of ₹3,000 after the member reaches 60 years of age, and offers optional enrollment in the PMSYM scheme for workers aged 18–40.
